name: Feeding the Hungry
description: The colony is running low on food. Everyone must contribute.

failEffect.description: Survivors go hungry. -1 morale.

name: Winter Rations
description: Supplies are critically short. The colony needs 3 food.

failEffect.description: Starvation sets in. -2 morale.

name: Outbreak
description: A disease spreads through the colony. 2 medicine needed.

failEffect.description: Survivors succumb. -2 morale, 1 random survivor takes a wound.

name: Frostbite
description: The cold is unbearable. Survivors need medicine to treat frostbite.

failEffect.description: Frostbite spreads. Each survivor takes 1 wound.

name: Power Outage
description: The generator is out of fuel. 2 fuel needed.

failEffect.description: Power out. -1 morale and +1 zombie spawns next round.

name: Vehicle Run
description: A supply run vehicle needs fuel. 3 fuel required.

failEffect.description: Run fails. -1 morale.

name: Breach
description: Zombies are breaking through the perimeter. 2 weapons needed to stop them.

failEffect.description: Zombies pour in. +3 zombies at colony, -1 morale.

name: Bandit Threat
description: Armed bandits are threatening the colony. 3 weapons required to deter them.

failEffect.description: Bandits steal supplies. -1 morale, lose 2 food.

name: Structural Damage
description: The colony walls need urgent repair. 2 tools needed.

failEffect.description: Walls weaken. Next zombie at colony ignores all barricades.

name: Broken Equipment
description: Critical equipment has broken down. 2 tools needed to fix it.

failEffect.description: Equipment remains broken. Searches yield one fewer item next round.

name: Fear and Doubt
description: Survivors are losing hope. Something must be done to boost morale.

failEffect.description: Despair spreads. -2 morale.

name: Dwindling Faith
description: Trust in leadership is eroding. Contribute any 4 cards to show unity.

failEffect.description: Colony fractures. -2 morale, 1 exile vote triggered.

name: Feeding the Children
description: The colony's youngest members need feeding first. 2 food required.

failEffect.description: Children go hungry. -2 morale.

name: Zombie Bite
description: A survivor has been bitten. The wound must be treated immediately. 3 medicine required.

failEffect.description: Infection spreads. Survivor eliminated. -2 morale.

name: Perimeter Hold
description: A zombie surge is testing the perimeter. 4 weapons needed to hold the line.

failEffect.description: Breach! +4 zombies at colony. -2 morale.

name: Generator Failure
description: The backup generator is failing. 4 fuel needed to run it through the night.

passEffect.description: Generator holds. Colony stays heated. No morale loss.

failEffect.description: Generator fails. Frostbite risk. -1 morale, each survivor takes 1 wound.

name: Collapsed Tunnel
description: An escape tunnel has collapsed. 3 tools needed to dig survivors out.

failEffect.description: Tunnel lost. 1 random survivor takes 2 wounds. -1 morale.

name: Last Resort
description: Everything is on the line. Contribute any 5 cards to keep the colony together.

failEffect.description: Colony splinters. -3 morale.

name: Spoiled Supplies
description: The food stores have spoiled. 3 food needed to replace them.

failEffect.description: Colony goes hungry. -2 morale, lose 1 food.

name: Epidemic
description: A fast-spreading illness tears through the colony. 4 medicine needed urgently.

failEffect.description: Colony ravaged. -3 morale, all survivors take 1 wound.
